text:
In a quaint mountain village, the ancient spirit known as the Keeper selects young Kai, a mischievous and unlikely candidate, as his new apprentice to safeguard the village’s history and secrets. Through a series of trials, Kai evolves from an impulsive boy into a thoughtful guardian, learning to respect tradition and gaining profound wisdom. This transformation ensures that the village’s stories and customs will be preserved for future generations.

The fastest land animal in the world is the cheetah.
